title: EC2 Server Monitoring
description: CPU, memory, swap, disk space, disk I/O, network, services and monitoring-stack metrics from Node Exporter + Prometheus.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: How long the server has been running since the last boot.

panels.title: CPU Cores
panels.description: Number of vCPUs (t3.micro = 2).

panels.title: Total RAM
panels.description: Total physical memory.

panels.title: Root Disk Size
panels.description: Total size of the root (/) filesystem.

panels.title: CPU Busy
panels.description: Current CPU utilization across all cores.

panels.title: RAM Used
panels.description: Percentage of RAM in use (excluding reclaimable cache).

panels.title: Swap Used
panels.description: Percentage of swap in use. Shows 'No data' if swap is not configured.

panels.title: Root Disk Used
panels.description: Percentage of the root (/) disk that is used.

panels.title: Scrape Targets
panels.description: Is Prometheus able to scrape each target? UP = healthy, DOWN = failing.

panels.title: Services
panels.description: Is each systemd service (prometheus, grafana-server, node_exporter) active? UP = running.

panels.title: CPU Utilization
panels.description: Overall CPU usage over time (100% = all cores fully busy).

panels.title: CPU Usage by Mode
panels.description: Where CPU time goes: user = applications, system = kernel, iowait = waiting for disk, steal = taken by the hypervisor.

panels.title: Load Average
panels.description: Average number of processes running or waiting. Consistently above the CPU core count = overloaded.

panels.title: CPU Steal & IOWait
panels.description: Steal: CPU taken away by AWS (high when t3 CPU credits run out). IOWait: CPU idle waiting for disk.

panels.title: Memory Usage
panels.description: Used = Total - Available. 'Free' is completely unused RAM; 'Available' also counts cache Linux can release.

panels.title: Memory Utilization %
panels.description: RAM usage percentage over time.

panels.title: Swap Usage
panels.description: How much swap is in use.

panels.title: Swap Activity
panels.description: Pages moved between RAM and swap per second. Constant activity = not enough RAM.

panels.title: OOM Kills (24h)
panels.description: Processes killed by the kernel for lack of memory in the last 24 hours. Should be 0.

panels.title: Disk Space Used % (per mount)
panels.description: Current usage of each mounted filesystem.

panels.title: Disk Space Used
panels.description: Bytes used on each filesystem.

panels.title: Disk Space Available
panels.description: Free space that normal users/processes can still write.

panels.title: Disk Space Used % Over Time
panels.description: Trend of disk usage. Useful to predict when the disk will fill up.

panels.title: Inodes Used %
panels.description: Inodes = number of files. A disk can be 'full' from too many small files even with free space.

panels.title: Disk Utilization (% busy)
panels.description: Percentage of time the disk was busy with I/O. Near 100% = disk is a bottleneck.

panels.title: Disk Throughput
panels.description: Bytes read from and written to disk per second.

panels.title: Disk IOPS
panels.description: Read and write operations per second (gp3 EBS baseline = 3000 IOPS).

panels.title: Disk Latency
panels.description: Average time per read/write operation. Gaps are normal when there is no I/O.

panels.title: Network Traffic
panels.description: Network bandwidth in bits per second.

panels.title: Network Packets
panels.description: Packets per second.

panels.title: Network Errors & Drops
panels.description: Should stay at 0. Non-zero values indicate network problems.

panels.title: TCP Connections
panels.description: Number of TCP connections by state.

panels.title: Processes
panels.description: Processes currently running or blocked.

panels.title: Context Switches & Interrupts
panels.description: How often the CPU switches between tasks and handles hardware interrupts.

panels.title: Open File Descriptors
panels.description: Number of open files/sockets system-wide.

panels.title: Time Sync Offset
panels.description: Clock difference from the time server (NTP / Amazon Time Sync). Should stay close to 0.

panels.title: Memory Used by Monitoring Stack
panels.description: RAM used by Prometheus, Grafana and Node Exporter processes.

panels.title: Prometheus Active Time Series
panels.description: Number of time series Prometheus is tracking. More series = more RAM.

panels.title: Prometheus Storage Size
panels.description: Disk space used by Prometheus data in /var/lib/prometheus.
